title: 自动任务系统优先级混乱
description: 自动任务系统选择工作缺乏逻辑，经常忽略名单中设置的优先级，浪费大量游戏时间。
evidence: It seems to follow absolutely no logic or reason to picking jobs, and often seems to ignore priorities set in the roster, which wastes enormous amounts of in game time
